name: 33131 · Miami, FL
findings: ZIP 33131 (Miami) has 289 nonprofit organizations. 85 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 69 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33131 (Miami) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
55% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 33131 (Miami) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 69 organizations here; 62% of all organizations here have no identified type.
